name: read_comparisons

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,re
lane=Path.cwd()
for n in ['zerosum','intersections']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(lane/'sources'/f'{n}.pdf'),'-'],text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{n}.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print(n, 'chars',len(r.stdout));print(r.stdout[:17500] if n=='zerosum' else '\n'.join(r.stdout.splitlines()[:55]));print('CLAIM locations',[(m.start(),r.stdout[m.start():m.start()+150]) for m in re.finditer(r'Theorem [1-4]\.|necklace|Conjecture',r.stdout)][:35])
